notes: C's exact no-skill gate is covered by the shared command no-skill vehicle; this handler has the same audited message and early return.
With the table position gate satisfied but no resolved target and no FIGHTING(ch), C emits Disembowel who.

An absent typed target falls back to FIGHTING(ch), matching C's pointer precedence.
A resolved target with no wielded actor weapon reaches the exact requirement gate.
A wielded non-piercing weapon reaches the exact disembowel weapon-type refusal.
A mounted actor is refused before either percentage draw.
A standing target can take the normal-player percentage failure; the result routes zero damage through skill_message set 184 without improving.
The actor receives the native Disembowel message-set bytes, with the wielded dagger substituted for $p.
The hit arm preserves the fixed level*2+damroll damage, StartCombat, two-round wait, and deferred improve after the C percent/probability, d20, and weapon-dice draws.
